subtitles.manhunt.search_a: The Hunter: I don't need to see you. I just need you to exist.

subtitles.manhunt.trap_done: The Hunter: I closed it gently. Doors deserve that.
subtitles.manhunt.respawn_a: The Hunter: Fifteen seconds. Count them with me.
subtitles.manhunt.hurt_a: The Hunter: Yes. That's the part I like.
subtitles.manhunt.kill_a: The Hunter: Shh. It's over. I'm here.
subtitles.manhunt.ghost_check: Whisper: I'm not behind you. Check anyway.
subtitles.manhunt.sight_b: Whisper: you're always right where I left you.
subtitles.manhunt.search_b: Whisper: I was in your caves first.
subtitles.manhunt.stalk_close: Whisper: you can hear me breathing now.
